editor.convertDescription: Every feature moves to where it lies on the map now. The floor plan image, the plane grid and the placement are dropped. This cannot be turned back into a plane.
editor.convertTitle: Draw this layout on the map?
editor.deleteDescription: It is removed from the layout when you save. Anything that refers to it by its id loses its place.
editor.drawOnGeoHelp: Features are drawn in real coordinates on the map.
editor.drawOnPlaneHelp: A plane with its own grid, optionally on a floor plan. You can place it on the map later.
editor.hint: Draw with the tools on the left, or tap a feature to edit it.
editor.hintReadOnly: Tap a feature to see it.
editor.label: Label
editor.labelHelp: Shown on the layout and in the details.
editor.noKinds: No feature kinds may be drawn here.
editor.noLocation: Set the location of the site first: the map opens on it.
editor.placeHelp: Drag the middle handle to move the plan, the top handle to turn it and the corner handle to scale it.
editor.removeUnderlayDescription: The image is no longer shown under the layout. Drawn features stay where they are.
editor.snapHelp: Rounds corners and points to a grid of {size} units.
editor.snapMetresHelp: Rounds corners and points to a grid of {size} on the ground.
editor.underlayHelp: A floor plan image to draw on: PNG, JPEG or WebP.
editor.underlayPickerHelp: One at a time. Map tiles need the placement on the map.
editor.underlaySize: {width} by {height} pixels, one unit per pixel.
editor.underlayType: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
editor.unplaceDescription: The layout is no longer shown on the map or over the site map. The map tiles underlay and the metre grid turn off. Drawn features stay where they are on the plane.
editor.unplaceTitle: Remove the placement on the map?
editor.unplacedHelp: Place the plan on the map to show it over the site map and to draw on the map tiles.
editor.unsupported: This property cannot be edited here.
editor.wrongGeometry: This kind cannot have this shape: choose another kind.

location.drawArea: Draw the area on the map, corner by corner.
location.tap: Tap the map to place the location.

view.loadFailed: The map could not be loaded.
